items.alt: Painting in the NGNTRP style: a Centauromachia
items.prompt: In the NGNTRP style, a painting of the 'Centauromachia' after Piero di Cosimo, heavy impasto brushstrokes, visible paint application, abstract.
items.training_data: 46 original paintings by the artist plus 300 public-domain / CC0 images from the PD12M dataset (CDLA-Permissive-2.0, dataset revision 867988b0), used as regularisation.
